symptom: my SHT31 humidity sensor won't read. The Adafruit example just hangs.

files.sht.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_sht31d import SHT31D
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
s = SHT31D(i2c)
print(s.relative_humidity)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device at 0x44 (68). The SHT31 has two addresses: 0x44 (ADDR pin low, the default) and 0x45 (ADDR pin high). The scan confirms 0x44, so pass address=0x44 explicitly so the driver targets it rather than relying on its probe.
